claims_reviewed.review_note: Homogeneous lifting, localization zero criterion, injectivity and restriction compatibility prove the actual short exact sequence; arbitrary variable set and every finite vertex are retained.
The Laurent-monomial decomposition, signed contraction and finite all-negative-exponent top contribution are correct over every commutative R, including the empty variable set and zero divisors.
The one bound 1+sum of absolute shifts makes every summand positive before every cohomological degree; finite cohomology does not require R Noetherian.
Successive kernels remain graded and finite by Noetherianity; the finite recursion is chosen before the degree and asserts no finite global dimension or termination of the resolution.
The explicit lift, boundary correction and final descent prove exactness transfer, including the bottom-degree zero-term convention.
A list of nu+1 free presentations suffices for every cohomological degree because the augmented complex has length nu; one maximum precedes all twists and degrees.
Inherited FCD10 supplies one finite homogeneous K; inclusion is bijective at each nonempty localization by actual power saturation and injectivity, without a false empty-vertex claim.

The exact ASL dehomogenization and FCD13 quotient identify finite chart modules; ASL16 projectivity is used only on affine charts. One K and its actual inclusion give the original all-integer section-cube model over arbitrary R.
The original ordinary degree-one complex is augmented degree two, and nonempty-vertex bijections suffice to transport the exact Cube.d 1/Cube.d 2 relation.
The corrected primitives phi_(a,tau(k))+u_k glue on each original cover member and give the original coboundary. Arbitrary index sets and restrictions are preserved.

Both directions of the coordinate/section equivalence retain the original chart assignments, transition units and every smaller-open cocycle identity; refinement descent returns to the original cover.
Two distinct common powers are used: the first extends finitely many sections, the second kills the overlap discrepancies on entire pairwise intersections. No zero divisor is cancelled.

The power unit-ideal identity gives an explicit primitive on a finite principal cover, and quasi-compact refinement plus SHV10 handles every original affine-open cover. No Noetherian assumption is added.

Differences of local primitives glue to a cocycle on the prescribed cover; solving it corrects and glues the primitives on the arbitrary test cover, without affine-intersection or finiteness assumptions.
The original differential has u_j-u_i and x_jk-x_ik+x_ij; the required primitive is -u. Antisymmetry and sorting recover every ordered cocycle identity, including repeated indices.
Affine all-cover vanishing, exact prescribed-cover signs and cover locality prove the complete original FirstCohomologyVanishes predicate from the literal finite secCube exactness premise.

The full original Serre H1 statement holds at every Noetherian base, every actual line bundle M and all sufficiently large integer twists. Its threshold precedes every cover/cocycle, with no smoothness or global base-change premise.

Only the finite span K requires Noetherian exactness; the ambient G may be infinite. Singleton-localization compatibility and the separate common-power-torsion hypothesis give exact high-degree membership.
Graded components are killed separately, and section cancellation takes place only on the original nonzero loci; covering sheaf equality gives zero globally.
Homogenization works for arbitrary variable sets, arbitrary containing submodules and negative source degree; only finite polynomial support is used, and epsilon-surjectivity is not added.

The original trivial-bundle degree-zero section supplies one cyclic span, and the high-degree homogeneous component returns one polynomial on every original chart with the original cst map. Its natural threshold and the independent M-dependent Serre threshold have exactly the two original quantifier orders.
